title: Argentinian Prawn Ceviche
description: A refreshing and zesty ceviche dish made with argentinian prawns, marinated in lime juice and mixed with onions, peppers, and cilantro.
instructions: Rinse the prawns under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
Cut the prawns into small pieces and place them in a large bowl.
Squeeze the lime juice over the prawns and mix well.
Add the sliced onion, bell pepper, and cucumber to the bowl and mix well.
Add the chopped cilantro and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the prawns to marinate.
Just before serving, stir the ceviche well and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
Serve the ceviche in small glasses or bowls and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
